posts.text:
Fifty-seven years ago, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin inspired the world by taking man’s first steps on the moon. 

Today, Alabama proudly carries that spirit of innovation forward through the world-class work at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center and our dominant aerospace and defense industries.
posts.summary: Celebrates Alabama's aerospace innovation and NASA contributions

posts.text:
Ms. Oyer sells hoodies on Substack claiming she stands up to bullies.

But when she recommended that President Biden commute the death sentences of Daniel Troya and Ricardo Sanchez Jr.—who brutally murdered an entire family of four—she made one thing crystal clear:

She doesn't stand up to bullies, she stands with them.
posts.summary: Opposes commuting death sentences for murder convicts
